title.en: Elicit: Research Agent and systematic review workflow
title.zh: Elicit：Research Agent 与系统综述工作流
title.cn: Elicit：Research Agent 与系统综述工作流

content.en: Elicit helps researchers find papers, screen studies and build extraction tables that they can check against the original text.
content.zh: Elicit 帮助研究者寻找论文、筛选研究并建立提取表，再对照原文逐项核查。 来源片段便于复核，但最终报告只覆盖套餐允许的一部分研究。
content.cn: Elicit 帮助研究者寻找论文、筛选研究并建立提取表，再对照原文逐项核查。 来源片段便于复核，但最终报告只覆盖套餐允许的一部分研究。

detail.en:
Use Research Agent for new paper searches, extraction tables and questions about selected papers. Dedicated Systematic Reviews on Pro, Scale or Enterprise guide a defined question through gathering, screening, extraction and reporting. Source passages support checking each result; the final report covers a plan-limited subset of studies. This is an editorial review of public documentation and independent historical use, not a hands-on accuracy test.

Best for: Researchers with a defined review protocol who can verify extracted values against full text.; Teams comparing studies in structured tables and budgeting for paid review and export features.

Not ideal for: Projects expecting exhaustive literature coverage or reliable non-English results from one tool.; Teams needing automatic study-quality judgments or a clearly documented guarantee that their data will not be used for training on any plan.

Limitations: Check numbers, context, screening decisions and citations manually; supplement searches with relevant databases.; Full-text work requires accessible or lawfully supplied papers. Figure extraction needs Scale/Enterprise plus premium parsing.; Legacy standalone sessions are read/export-only after 30 September 2026; export or migrate before their as-yet-unscheduled 2027 removal.

Pricing: Basic is free with limited Agent/Report usage. Dedicated reviews require Pro or above; Agent table export starts at Plus and review table export at Pro. Included monthly usage is shared and varies with task complexity. Paid price and exact allowance depend on the current account/billing view, which was not resolved here; verify checkout. Pro/Scale extra usage is optional and separately billed.

Privacy: Uploaded PDFs are described as encrypted, private and outside the public corpus. This does not establish a general no-training promise or deletion deadline for ordinary plans. API rules prohibit personal data and limit training of input to separate opt-in; Enterprise terms are separate.

Platforms: Web account; Chrome and Edge full-text extensions for eligible review plans. Native apps, offline operation and universal regional access are unverified.

Compare next: Consensus: Compare a paper discovery and cited-answer workflow when you mainly need to locate and read research; no superiority claim.; Gemini Notebook: Compare synthesis of selected sources when systematic screening and extraction tables are not the main task.

AI Best Tool provides public correction and owner-update entry points for this listing; submissions enter manual review. No user reviews or owner verification are claimed.

Preview: Elicit’s official 45-second Research Agent video, published August 5, 2026, is embedded from its YouTube channel. The listing tile and cover are AI Best Tool editorial assets, not an Elicit logo or product screenshot.
detail.zh:
新论文检索、数据提取和论文问答通过 Research Agent 开展。Pro、Scale 或 Enterprise 的专用系统综述流程围绕明确问题收集、筛选、提取并生成报告。来源片段便于复核，但最终报告只覆盖套餐允许的一部分研究。本稿依据公开官方文档和独立历史使用研究，未进行账号内准确性实测。

适合: 已有明确综述方案，能够取得全文并逐项核对提取值的研究者。; 需要用结构化表格比较研究，且能为专用综述和表格导出安排预算的团队。

不适合: 期待一个工具穷尽文献，或保证非英语检索与提取质量的项目。; 希望自动判断研究质量，或要求所有套餐均有已证不训练承诺的团队。

限制: 数字、语境、筛选决定及引用仍需人工核对，并按研究问题补查专业数据库。; 全文处理依赖合法访问或上传；图形提取需要 Scale/Enterprise 及高级 PDF 解析。; 2026 年 9 月 30 日前的独立工具会话现仅可查看和导出；应在尚未确定日期的 2027 年移除前导出或逐一迁移。

定价边界: Basic 免费，Agent/报告用量有限。专用综述需 Pro 起；Agent 表格导出需 Plus 起，综述表格导出需 Pro 起。月度用量池共享，消耗取决于任务复杂度。本轮未消歧目标账号和账期对应的价格及精确额度，采购时须核对结算页；Pro/Scale 可选额外付费用量。

隐私边界: 官方称上传 PDF 加密、仅账户可见且不进入公共语料；这不构成普通套餐统一不训练或限时彻底删除的承诺。API 禁止个人数据，输入训练须单独选择同意；Enterprise 条款另有范围。

平台: 网页账号；符合综述套餐资格时可用 Chrome/Edge 全文扩展。原生客户端、离线使用及全球地区可用性未经证实。

后续比较: Consensus: 主要需要发现论文并阅读带来源答案时，可比较该类流程，不作优劣排名。; Gemini Notebook: 主要需要综合已选资料，而非系统筛选和提取表时，可比较其资料综合路径。

本站已上线条目纠错及 owner 更新入口，提交内容进入人工审核；不宣称已有用户评论或 owner 核验。

预览：嵌入 Elicit 官方频道 2026-08-05 发布的 45 秒 Research Agent 视频。条目身份图和封面为 AI Best Tool 自有编辑素材，并非 Elicit 官方 logo 或产品截图。
